items.stem: Which TWO practices reduce automation bias among reviewers? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Show model uncertainty and any dissenting evidence
options.rationale: Correct: surfacing uncertainty prompts genuine review.

options.text: Rotate reviewers and cap their load
options.rationale: Correct: limiting load reduces fatigue-driven rubber-stamping.

options.text: Always hide confidence and force agreement with the model
options.rationale: This increases, not reduces, automation bias.
